title: ARMOUR AND STAMINA BARS ONE HEIGHT
why: The critic on the raid screen (10-19): three vitals bars with different heights; armour is 16 and stamina 12.
now: Armour and stamina bars are both 16 high with the same gap; health stays the tall hero bar.

edits.replacement: bar(16,by-50,HBW,16,p.armor/armorCap(),'#5aa9e6');   /* v28.xx (cw-barheight), the critic (2026-10-19): 'use three bars of the same height with the same gaps'. Armour and stamina are both 16 high with a 5 gap (stamina was 12), health stays the tall hero bar */
bar(16,by-29,HBW,16,p.stam/100,_stc);   /* v28.xx (cw-barheight): 16 high like the armour bar, same bottom edge as before */
ctx.fillText(p.stamLock?'WINDED':'STAMINA',16+HBW+8,by-17);   /* v28.xx (cw-barheight): centred on the taller bar */
var _up=(p.armor>0)?(50+LH(5)):(29+LH(5));   /* v28.xx (cw-barheight): the taller bars lift the chip 4 */
